d.g: People's Party for Freedom and Democracy
d.x: While it is highly unlikely that the Freedom Party will have any role in the coalition, due to the animosity between one-time VVD party colleagues Rutte and Wilders, Krouwel predicted that Wilders’ policies “will be dominant” as they dominated the election campaign.

VVD.e: Borrowed from Dutch VVD (“Volkspartij voor Vrijheid en Democratie”).
